bullets: Designed a modular backend pipeline system for LLM-driven resume optimization, transforming unstructured job descriptions into structured representations and tailored outputs
Modeled the system as a multi-stage processing pipeline including parsing, schema validation, experience retrieval, scoring, and resume generation with well-defined data contracts
Defined structured data schemas (e.g., JobDescription, ExperienceItem) using Pydantic to enforce consistency and enable deterministic processing across pipeline stages
Built a hybrid retrieval and ranking engine combining rule-based scoring with LLM-assisted semantic understanding to evaluate job fit and select relevant experiences
Integrated LLM APIs with structured prompt design for reliable information extraction and controlled JSON output generation
Designed concurrent processing strategy using multi-threading for parallel job processing, with planned migration to queue-based asynchronous architecture (e.g., task queues / Kafka)
Implemented fault-tolerant mechanisms including API retry, timeout control, stage-level failure isolation, and idempotent output generation
Designed system evolution roadmap from CLI-based workflow to web-based interface, and from local JSON storage to persistent database-backed architecture
impact_summary: Designed and implemented an extensible LLM-powered backend system that automates resume tailoring through structured data modeling, retrieval and ranking logic, and modular pipeline architecture, enabling scalable and reliable optimization workflows.
